s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Trim Panel Assembly Upper

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 clips and 4 claws, and remove the back door trim panel assembly upper.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Side Garnish LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin of the package tray trim garnish hook.
Disengage the clips and claws, and remove the back door side garnish LH together with the package tray trim garnish hook.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the package tray trim garnish hook.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Side Garnish RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove the RH side using the same procedure as for the LH side.

s2.ptxt: Insert a moulding remover at the position shown in the illustration, disengage the 4 claws as shown in the illustration, and remove the back door inside handle.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Trim Panel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove clip (A).
Disengage the 11 clips and remove the back door trim panel assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Wiper Arm Head Cap

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear wiper arm head cap.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear wiper arm nut and remove the rear wiper arm & blade assembly.
Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 3 bolts and remove the rear wiper motor assembly.
Remove the rear wiper motor grommet.
Remove the 2 plug hole covers.
Disconnect the connectors.
Remove the 4 nuts.
Disengage the clips and remove the rear spoiler assembly.
Disengage the 2 back door window glass spacers.

item.ptxt: Back door window glass spacer No.1 and back window glass spacer No.2 are installed at the positions on the back door glass shown in the illustration, so take care not to damage the back door glass when cutting.
Use a windshield knife or piano wire as appropriate, depending on the cutting location and conditions.
Because the back door glass may fall during the work, hold the back door glass from outside the vehicle using suction cups.

s2.ptxt: Apply protective tape to the body surface around the back door glass.

atten3.ptxt: When reusing the back door glass, before removing it, apply packing tape or equivalent to the back door glass and body panel, and make matchmarks with a pen for installation.

s2.ptxt: Remove the back window moulding outside.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the back door glass or body surface.
If the body surface is scratched, perform rust-proofing after removing the back door glass.

s2.ptxt: Using a utility knife, cut the back window moulding outside and back window moulding LWR.
Disconnect the 2 connectors from the back door glass.
Attach suction cups to the back door glass.
When using a windshield knife.

s3.ptxt: Apply plenty of soapy water to the glass bonded area.
Insert the windshield knife into the bonded area.

atten4.ptxt: Insert the windshield knife at a location where the gap between the glass and body is wide, and perform the work.

s3.ptxt: While keeping the blade at a right angle to the edge of the glass and matching the blade of the windshield knife to the glass surface and edge, pull it parallel to the edge of the glass to cut the adhesive.

atten3.ptxt: Never pry with the windshield knife.

s2.ptxt: When using piano wire

s3.ptxt: Pass piano wire (0.6mm is suitable) through as shown in the illustration, and attach both ends to a mighty puller.
Pull the piano wire alternately to cut the adhesive, leaving the clips.

item.ptxt: Do not let the piano wire contact the edge of the glass strongly.
Be careful, as the piano wire will break if crossed.

s2.ptxt: Holding the suction cups, disengage the 4 back door glass spacers and remove the back door glass.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful not to drop the back door glass.

s2.ptxt: Using a scraper, remove the back door glass spacer. (When reusing back door glass)

item.ptxt: Do not damage the back door glass.
Be sure to replace the removed back door glass spacer with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Window Glass Spacer NO.2

s2.ptxt: Using a scraper, remove back window glass spacer No.2. (When reusing back door glass)

item.ptxt: Do not damage the back door glass.
Be sure to replace the removed back window glass spacer No.2 with a new one.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Window Glass Spacer NO.1

s2.ptxt: Using a scraper, remove back door window glass spacer, NO.1. (When reusing back door glass)

item.ptxt: Do not damage the back door glass.
Be sure to replace the removed back door window glass spacer, NO.1 with a new one.
